help.description: Lists zones visible to the authenticated account or gets one zone by ZoneId. The list parameters are sent as optional API filters; the projection's generated values and the API's own defaults are not interchangeable. Output objects are typed Cloudflare.PowerShell.CfZone values and expose ZoneId as a PowerShell identity alias for Id.

parameterDescriptions.AccountId: Filters the zone list by account identifier.
parameterDescriptions.AccountName: Filters the zone list by account name.
parameterDescriptions.Direction: Controls the API list sort direction when supported. The value is passed to the API; no constrained value set is asserted here.
parameterDescriptions.Match: Controls how multiple zone-list filters are matched. The current projection initializer is all; this is not asserted as the Cloudflare API default.
parameterDescriptions.Name: Filters the zone list by zone name.
parameterDescriptions.Order: Selects the API zone-list sort field when supported. The value is passed to the API.
parameterDescriptions.Page: Sets the initial zone-list page. The shared paginator may request subsequent pages; this projection value is not a claim about an API-side default.
parameterDescriptions.PerPage: Requests the number of zones per page. The API may apply its own limit.
parameterDescriptions.Status: Filters the zone list by zone status.
parameterDescriptions.Type: Filters the zone list by one or more zone types.
parameterDescriptions.ZoneId: Identifies one zone for the Get parameter set. It can bind by property name from CfZone.ZoneId, including the ETS alias projected from CfZone.Id.

parameterSetDescriptions.List: Lists zones and writes one CfZone object per result. No ZoneId is required.
parameterSetDescriptions.Get: Gets one zone by its ZoneId and writes one CfZone object.

inputs.description: The list form does not require pipeline input.
A zone object can provide ZoneId by property name when the Get form is selected.

outputs.description: One typed zone object per returned zone.

examples.title: List zones
examples.remarks: Lists zones matching a placeholder name. Supply the normal module authentication configuration in the calling session.

examples.title: Get one zone
examples.remarks: Gets one zone by its placeholder identifier.

help.description: Lists DNS records in a zone or gets one DNS record by zone and record identifier. Filter parameters are optional API query inputs. Output objects are typed Cloudflare.PowerShell.CfDnsRecord values and expose DnsRecordId as a PowerShell identity alias for Id; a record does not carry its parent ZoneId.

parameterDescriptions.CommentAbsent: Filters for records without the specified comment value.
parameterDescriptions.CommentContains: Filters for records whose comment contains the supplied text.
parameterDescriptions.CommentEndswith: Filters for records whose comment ends with the supplied text.
parameterDescriptions.CommentExact: Filters for records whose comment exactly matches the supplied text.
parameterDescriptions.CommentPresent: Filters for records that have a comment.
parameterDescriptions.CommentStartswith: Filters for records whose comment starts with the supplied text.
parameterDescriptions.ContentContains: Filters for records whose content contains the supplied text.
parameterDescriptions.ContentEndswith: Filters for records whose content ends with the supplied text.
parameterDescriptions.ContentExact: Filters for records whose content exactly matches the supplied text.
parameterDescriptions.ContentStartswith: Filters for records whose content starts with the supplied text.
parameterDescriptions.Direction: Controls API list sort direction. The current projection initializer is asc; this is not asserted as the Cloudflare API default.
parameterDescriptions.DnsRecordId: Identifies one DNS record in the Get parameter set. RecordId is a compatibility alias. A CfDnsRecord object can provide this identity by property name through its ETS DnsRecordId alias, but it cannot provide the parent ZoneId.
parameterDescriptions.IncludeShadowMetadata: When explicitly supplied, requests shadow metadata in the API response. Omission leaves this optional query parameter unbound.
parameterDescriptions.Match: Controls how multiple record filters are matched. The current projection initializer is all; this is not asserted as the Cloudflare API default.
parameterDescriptions.Name: Matches the DNS record name.
parameterDescriptions.NameContains: Filters for records whose name contains the supplied text.
parameterDescriptions.NameEndswith: Filters for records whose name ends with the supplied text.
parameterDescriptions.NameExact: Filters for records whose name exactly matches the supplied text.
parameterDescriptions.NameStartswith: Filters for records whose name starts with the supplied text.
parameterDescriptions.Order: Selects the API list sort field. The current projection initializer is type; this is not asserted as the Cloudflare API default.
parameterDescriptions.Page: Sets the initial record-list page. The shared paginator requests subsequent pages until an empty page; this projection value is not a claim about an API-side default.
parameterDescriptions.PerPage: Requests the number of records per page. The API may apply its own limit.
parameterDescriptions.Proxied: Filters records by proxied state. The current projection initializer is false; omission is preferred when no proxied filter is intended.
parameterDescriptions.Search: Applies the API's broad record search text.
parameterDescriptions.ShadowedByName: Filters by the name of a record that shadows this record.
parameterDescriptions.ShadowingName: Filters by the name of a record shadowed by this record.
parameterDescriptions.Tag: Filters by one or more record tags.
parameterDescriptions.TagAbsent: Filters for records without the specified tag.
parameterDescriptions.TagContains: Filters for records whose tags contain the supplied text.
parameterDescriptions.TagEndswith: Filters for records whose tag value ends with the supplied text.
parameterDescriptions.TagExact: Filters for records with an exact tag match.
parameterDescriptions.TagMatch: Controls how tag filters are matched. The current projection initializer is all; this is not asserted as the Cloudflare API default.
parameterDescriptions.TagPresent: Filters for records that have the specified tag.
parameterDescriptions.TagStartswith: Filters for records whose tag value starts with the supplied text.
parameterDescriptions.Type: Filters the record list by DNS record type.
parameterDescriptions.ZoneId: Identifies the parent zone and is mandatory for both list and get. It can bind by property name from CfZone.ZoneId, including the ETS alias projected from CfZone.Id.

parameterSetDescriptions.List: Lists records in the required ZoneId. The shared paginator follows the API page results until an empty page.
parameterSetDescriptions.Get: Gets one record using both the required ZoneId and DnsRecordId. Supplying only a record object is insufficient because its parent zone is not inferable.

inputs.description: A CfZone object can provide ZoneId by property name for list or get.
A CfDnsRecord object can provide DnsRecordId by property name for Get, but -ZoneId must still be supplied explicitly.
Explicit ZoneId and, for Get, DnsRecordId values are also supported.

outputs.description: One typed DNS record object per result, or one object for the Get form.

examples.title: List records in a zone
examples.remarks: Lists records using a placeholder zone identifier and the shared paginator.

examples.title: Get one record
examples.remarks: Gets one record. RecordId is also accepted as an alias for DnsRecordId.

examples.title: Filter records
examples.remarks: Combines a type and exact-name filter. The values are placeholders and do not identify a real account.

examples.title: Pipe a zone identity
examples.remarks: The PowerShell projection exposes ZoneId as an ETS alias of CfZone.Id. A DNS-record object does not supply its parent scope; use -ZoneId explicitly when piping a record.

help.description: Creates a DNS record from a typed CfDnsRecordInput variant. Use CfARecordInput, CfMxRecordInput, CfCaaRecordInput, CfHttpsRecordInput, or CfSvcbRecordInput to construct the Record body. The operation supports ShouldProcess; use -WhatIf to inspect the action without sending a request.

parameterDescriptions.IncludeShadowMetadata: When explicitly supplied, requests shadow metadata in the API response. Omission leaves this optional query parameter unbound.
parameterDescriptions.Record: A concrete typed request object derived from CfDnsRecordInput. The concrete class determines the DNS record type and serializes only specified Optional properties.
parameterDescriptions.ZoneId: Identifies the parent zone and is mandatory. It can bind by property name from CfZone.ZoneId.

parameterSetDescriptions.Create: Creates one record with the mandatory ZoneId and typed Record body.

inputs.description: A CfZone object can provide ZoneId by property name.
The Record parameter accepts a concrete typed request variant.

outputs.description: The typed DNS record returned by the API after creation.

examples.title: Construct a typed A record safely
examples.remarks: This is a mock-safe construction example. WhatIf prevents the mutation request.

examples.title: Create a typed record
examples.remarks: After constructing a concrete typed input, remove -WhatIf only when the target and request are intentionally reviewed.

help.description: Removes one DNS record by its parent ZoneId and DnsRecordId. The operation has no success output and uses high-impact ShouldProcess confirmation; use -WhatIf before a real delete. RecordId is a compatibility alias for DnsRecordId.

parameterDescriptions.DnsRecordId: Identifies the DNS record to remove. RecordId is an alias. A CfDnsRecord object can provide this resource identity by property name, but it cannot provide the required parent ZoneId.
parameterDescriptions.ZoneId: Identifies the parent zone and is mandatory. Supply it explicitly when piping a CfDnsRecord.

parameterSetDescriptions.Delete: Deletes one record using both its parent ZoneId and DnsRecordId.

inputs.description: A CfZone object can provide ZoneId by property name.
A CfDnsRecord object can provide DnsRecordId by property name; ZoneId remains mandatory and must be explicit.
Explicit ZoneId and DnsRecordId values are also supported.

outputs.description: No object is written when the delete succeeds or when -WhatIf prevents the request.

examples.title: Review a delete with WhatIf
examples.remarks: Shows the high-impact action without sending a delete request.

examples.title: Pipe record identity with explicit scope
examples.remarks: The record supplies DnsRecordId through the PowerShell identity alias; ZoneId is intentionally explicit because record output does not contain parent scope.

help.description: Edits or replaces one DNS record by ZoneId and DnsRecordId. Use exactly one body parameter: -Edit sends a partial PATCH-style body, while -Replace sends a complete PUT-style body. The operation supports high-impact ShouldProcess and -WhatIf.

parameterDescriptions.DnsRecordId: Identifies the DNS record to update. RecordId is an alias. A CfDnsRecord object can provide this resource identity by property name, but it cannot provide the required parent ZoneId.
parameterDescriptions.Edit: A Hashtable containing only fields to change. This parameter selects the Edit set and is serialized as a PATCH-style request body.
parameterDescriptions.IncludeShadowMetadata: When explicitly supplied, requests shadow metadata in the API response. Omission leaves this optional query parameter unbound.
parameterDescriptions.Replace: A Hashtable containing the replacement record representation. This parameter selects the default Replace set and is serialized as a PUT-style request body.
parameterDescriptions.ZoneId: Identifies the parent zone and is mandatory. Supply it explicitly when piping a CfDnsRecord.

parameterSetDescriptions.Replace: The default set sends one replacement Hashtable using PUT semantics. Provide exactly one -Replace body.
parameterSetDescriptions.Edit: The Edit set sends a partial Hashtable using PATCH semantics. Provide exactly one -Edit body.

inputs.description: A CfZone object can provide ZoneId by property name.
A CfDnsRecord object can provide DnsRecordId by property name; ZoneId remains mandatory and must be explicit.
The Edit or Replace body is a Hashtable; exactly one body parameter is accepted per invocation.

outputs.description: The typed DNS record returned by the API after the edit or replacement.

examples.title: Edit selected fields
examples.remarks: Edit uses PATCH-style semantics and sends only the fields in the Hashtable. WhatIf keeps this example safe.

examples.title: Replace a record
examples.remarks: Replace uses PUT-style semantics. The Hashtable is a placeholder representation; review required fields for the target record before removing WhatIf.
